Carrier existence is provider-documented; the span and the value policy are project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided 2026-10-06 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#243. Question: Which parts of the cross-cluster key's request and response can be asserted as not the key? Options: Assert the binding attribute, the privilege property and placeholder, masked and empty members; or also assert the id; or assert none. Decision: Assert the binding attribute, the access property and the placeholder, masked and empty members; leave the id unasserted. Reason: The contract states the certificate identity is outside the encoded credential and the access property is the privilege; the id's confidentiality is an open question inherited from the user key. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's explicit instruction of 2026-10-06 (complete redact-secret#1228, #1229 and #1230 before the next release; Cases for these groups are authored maintainer-only, as in Batch 2).
events.dissent: No dissent was raised. The strongest counter-argument, recorded because the rule asks for one: A certificate distinguished-name pattern can still reveal infrastructure naming that an operator may want redacted for other reasons; a masked member may be a truncated real value.
